title: 358-The Lost Temple Of Java (Java'nın Kayıp Tapınağı)

sentences.englishText: In 1814, Thomas Raffles, the Governor of Java, heard stories about big ruins in the center of the island and set off to find them.
sentences.turkishText: 1814'te, Java Valisi Thomas Raffles, adanın merkezindeki büyük harabelerle ilgili hikayeler duydu ve onları bulmak için yola çıktı.

sentences.englishText: He was astonished to find one of the most magnificent buildings he had ever seen, almost completely covered by the plants and tall trees of the jungle.
sentences.turkishText: Neredeyse tamamen ormanın bitkileri ve uzun ağaçlarıyla kaplı, gördüğü en muhteşem yapılardan birini bulunca hayrete düştü.

sentences.englishText: It took 200 men two weeks to clear the area and reveal Borobudur, a beautiful Buddhist temple made of 1.6 million blocks of stone.
sentences.turkishText: Bölgeyi temizlemek ve 1,6 milyon taş bloktan yapılmış güzel bir Budist tapınağı olan Borobudur'u ortaya çıkarmak 200 adamın iki haftasını aldı.

sentences.englishText: The temple has four square levels and three higher circular levels, decorated with bell-shaped towers and statues of the Buddha.
sentences.turkishText: Tapınağın dört kare katı ve üç daha yüksek dairesel katı vardır, çan şeklindeki kuleler ve Buda heykelleriyle süslenmiştir.

sentences.englishText: Reaching the top of the temple, where only kings and priests were allowed, is an extraordinary experience, with a sense of space, light, and air.
sentences.turkishText: Sadece kralların ve rahiplerin girmesine izin verilen tapınağın tepesine ulaşmak, mekan, ışık ve hava hissi ile olağanüstü bir deneyimdir.

sentences.englishText: Borobudur was built in the 8th and 9th centuries by the Saliendra Kings, who had grown very rich and powerful from the trade in rice and spices.
sentences.turkishText: Borobudur, pirinç ve baharat ticaretinden çok zengin ve güçlü hale gelen Saliendra Kralları tarafından 8. ve 9. yüzyıllarda inşa edildi.

sentences.englishText: At the beginning of the 10th century, an epidemic and a major volcanic eruption brought a sudden end to the civilization, and the temple was abandoned.
sentences.turkishText: 10. yüzyılın başında, bir salgın ve büyük bir volkanik patlama uygarlığın aniden sona ermesine neden oldu ve tapınak terk edildi.

sentences.englishText: Soon plants began to cover the statues, and the temple was forgotten for nearly a thousand years until its rediscovery by Raffles.
sentences.turkishText: Kısa süre sonra bitkiler heykelleri kaplamaya başladı ve tapınak, Raffles tarafından yeniden keşfedilene kadar yaklaşık bin yıl boyunca unutuldu.

enrichment.summary: In 1814, Thomas Raffles, the Governor of Java, heard stories about big ruins in the center of the island and set off to find them. He was astonished to find one of the most magnificent buildings he had ever seen, almost completely covered by the plants and tall trees of the jungle.
